description: 30 deterministic self-graded tasks for the 0.13 context-rot curve. Facts for needle tasks are stated at session start; no judge model is used.

coding.prompt: In the workspace, fix only the sumRange function in src/bugs.js so it sums the integers from 1 through n inclusive. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the reverseWords function in src/bugs.js so it reverses the order of the words but keeps each word spelled normally. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the uniqueSorted function in src/bugs.js so it removes duplicate values and returns the result in ascending order. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the chunk function in src/bugs.js so the final short chunk is included. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the parseKeyValues function in src/bugs.js so it parses lines in the form key=value. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the clamp function in src/bugs.js so the value is bounded by min and max. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the countVowels function in src/bugs.js so it counts a, e, i, o and u and does not count y. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the flattenOne function in src/bugs.js so it flattens exactly one array level. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the formatCents function in src/bugs.js so the cents part is always two digits. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.
In the workspace, fix only the binarySearch function in src/bugs.js so it searches the whole array and returns -1 when the target is absent. Do not edit any test. Use the tools, then reply DONE.

needle.fact: The spare key is kept under the blue ceramic pot.
needle.question: Where would I look for the backup access item? Reply with the location only.

needle.fact: Mira's flight leaves at 06:15 from gate C7.
needle.question: At what hour does she depart? Reply with the time only.

needle.fact: The quarterly budget was set to 74,300 credits.
needle.question: How much money was allocated for the period? Reply with the amount only.

needle.fact: The archive password rotates every ninth day.
needle.question: How often does the secret change? Reply with the interval only.

needle.fact: The nearest repair shop is two blocks east of the fountain.
needle.question: Where should I take the broken item? Reply with the location only.
needle.answer: two blocks east of the fountain

needle.fact: The experiment used a sample of 1,280 seeds.
needle.question: How many items were in the trial? Reply with the number only.

needle.fact: The northern trail closes after the first heavy snowfall.
needle.question: When does that route become unavailable? Reply with the condition only.

needle.fact: Dr. Okafor's office is on the fourth floor, room 412.
needle.question: Which room is the physician in? Reply with the room number only.

needle.fact: The backup runs at 22:45 every second Friday.
needle.question: When is the next copy made? Reply with the schedule only.

needle.fact: The replacement part costs 37 dollars and 50 cents.
needle.question: What is the price? Reply with the amount only.

tools.question: In the workspace, read data/records.json, add {"id":"b","name":"Grace"}, sort by id, and write the array back to the same file. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/state.json and data/delta.txt, add the integer from delta.txt to count, and write state.json. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/config.json, remove the debug field, set retries to 5, and write the object back. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/notes.md, append a line containing gamma, and write the file back. Keep the existing lines. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/items.json, keep one item per id using the last occurrence, sort by id, and write the array back. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/people.json, change bob's age to 42, add cid with age 25, and write the object back. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/numbers.txt, remove duplicate lines, sort the remaining integers ascending, and write one per line. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/orders.json, keep only orders whose status is shipped, and write the array back. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/settings.json, set server.host to new, append 8080 to server.ports, and write the object back. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
Read data/left.json and data/right.json, merge them into one object where right wins on conflicts, and write the result to data/merged.json. Use tools. Then reply DONE.
